notes: Bounded operator/ops follow-on work after the reviewed PATLAW-000..164 board drains. No unattended Hub main publish, Patent Center login, payment, signature, or auto-push.

tasks.title: Validate production completion-gate artifacts and evidence bundle offline
tasks.acceptance: Offline completion-gate and production-status both report a coherent drained-or-completed projection with required evidence paths present or explicitly gap-listed; no contentful private data is printed.
tasks.preconditions: PATLAW-164 completion-gate implementation is merged on feature/patent-legal-intelligence.
tasks.effects: Produces a durable offline validation receipt and operator-readable production status snapshot for the current tree.
tasks.conflict_policy: Own only post-completion validation docs/receipts and non-breaking status/gate fixes; do not reopen foundation board tasks or weaken privacy gates.

tasks.title: Assemble feature-branch PR package without auto-push
tasks.acceptance: A local PR package summarizes commits, changed paths, completion receipts, and human-required push/PR steps; no git push or remote publish occurs.
tasks.preconditions: Offline completion validation has a non-blocking or explicitly acknowledged gap list.
tasks.effects: Creates an operator handoff package for opening or updating a GitHub PR on feature/patent-legal-intelligence.
tasks.conflict_policy: Never push, force-push, or open authenticated remote PRs unattended; package only.

tasks.title: Run optional live official-source canary with offline fallback
tasks.acceptance: Canary defaults to offline fixtures; optional live mode records bounded eCFR/GovInfo/Federal Register/ODP probes with receipts and never mutates private matter state.
tasks.preconditions: Completion-gate validation exists and privacy boundary policy remains enforced.
tasks.effects: Adds a bounded live/offline canary operator tool and tests.
tasks.conflict_policy: Live network access is optional and receipt-bound; never store private portfolio content in public receipts.

tasks.title: Exercise Hub release dry-run staging verification
tasks.acceptance: Dry-run staging verifies manifests, DLP/rights gates, and viewer contracts without uploading to main or mutating remote default branches.
tasks.preconditions: HF release builder and DLP/rights gates from the drained board are merged.
tasks.effects: Proves the publication path in dry-run mode and records a staging receipt for human approval.
tasks.conflict_policy: No authenticated main upload or unattended approve/publish; dry-run and local staging only.

tasks.title: Seal operator production handoff receipt and completed status projection
tasks.acceptance: A single handoff receipt binds offline gate results, PR package path, canary disposition, Hub dry-run receipt, exact tree SHA, and remaining human actions; production_status can surface completed when mandatory evidence is present.
tasks.preconditions: PR package, canary, and Hub dry-run tasks have completed or recorded explicit waived gaps.
tasks.effects: Closes the post-completion ops phase with an operator-ready handoff artifact.
tasks.conflict_policy: Do not auto-push, auto-file, or mark legal sign-off complete without a natural-person action.

tasks.title: Materialize public patent-law and regulations corpus for Hub release
tasks.acceptance: Deterministic public legal corpus materialization with rights and source receipts; private inputs fail closed.
tasks.preconditions: Legal source acquisition and HF release contracts are merged.
tasks.effects: Produces public corpus ready for BM25/vector/graph builders.
tasks.conflict_policy: Own corpus materializer only; no Hub upload.

tasks.title: Build production BM25 index snapshot for public legal corpus
tasks.acceptance: Deterministic BM25 snapshot bound to corpus root.
tasks.preconditions: Public corpus materializer and index contracts available.
tasks.conflict_policy: Own BM25 builder only; no Hub upload.

tasks.title: Build production vector index snapshot for public legal corpus
tasks.acceptance: Vector snapshot binds model pin and corpus root.
tasks.preconditions: Pinned local embeddings and public corpus available.
tasks.conflict_policy: Own vector builder only; no Hub upload.

tasks.title: Build production knowledge-graph snapshot for public legal corpus
tasks.acceptance: Graph snapshot has no orphan edges and cites source receipts.
tasks.preconditions: Public corpus and graph snapshot contracts available.
tasks.conflict_policy: Own graph builder only; no Hub upload.

tasks.title: Package multi-artifact corpus BM25 vector and graph Hub release
tasks.acceptance: Package binds corpus and all three index families.
tasks.conflict_policy: Package only; dry-run default; no upload.

tasks.title: Admit hub index package through DLP rights and Viewer gates
Stage authenticated Hub PR for corpus BM25 vector and graph artifacts
tasks.acceptance: Staged PR path with exact approval; no unattended main publish.
tasks.preconditions: Admitted package and publisher v2 available.

tasks.title: Verify pinned Hub redownload of BM25 vector and graph artifacts
Build operator promote checklist for Hub index publication
tasks.acceptance: Exact-digest operator promote checklist without auto-promote.
tasks.preconditions: Staged PR and package receipts exist.

tasks.title: Seal Hub index publication receipt distinguishing staged vs promoted
tasks.acceptance: Receipt distinguishes staged vs promoted without fabricating live success.
tasks.preconditions: Verify receipt and promote checklist exist.
tasks.conflict_policy: No fabricated promoted state; no unattended Hub write.
